name: collection-preferences
purpose: The preferences panel of a collection, after Cloudscape's collection preferences: a cog button opens a dialog (or a drawer) with the page size, the columns (shown, hidden and ordered; a locked column always shows), wrapped lines, striped rows and density. Changes are a draft until Confirm; Cancel, `Esc` and the close button discard them. It holds no saved state itself: `useCollection` saves the confirmed value in `localStorage` and `preferencesProps` binds the value, the columns and the page sizes in one `v-bind`.
useWhen: A table or card collection whose people choose how many items a page shows and which fields they see.
Any collection driven by `useCollection`, which saves the result per collection.
avoidWhen: A single column-visibility toggle inside a table toolbar → use `table-column-selector`.
Settings of the resource itself (not of how the list shows it) → use a form page or `dialog`.
related: use-collection` — saves the preferences; `preferencesProps` is the binding.
table` — takes `density`, `wrapLines`, `striped`, the visible columns and their order.
cards` — takes the page size and the visible fields.
property-filter` — sits beside it in the controls row.
bestPractices: Lock the column that names the item (`locked: true`): a row without its name is unreadable.
Show only the sections the collection uses (`sections`): cards have no striped rows.
Keep the trigger at the end of the controls row, after Refresh and Download.

props.name: preferences
props.doc: The saved preferences. Supports v-model:preferences; changes apply on Confirm.

props.name: columns
props.doc: Columns to show, hide and order. Empty hides the columns section.

props.name: pageSizeOptions
props.doc: Page sizes offered. Empty hides the page size section.

props.name: sections
props.doc: Sections the panel shows, in this order.

props.name: container
props.doc: Opens in a centered dialog or a side drawer.

props.name: title
props.doc: Panel title and trigger label. Empty uses the locale catalog.

events.name: confirm
events.notes: Same value, for a handler that is not a model.

events.name: cancel
events.notes: Cancel was activated; the draft is discarded.

slots.name: trigger
slots.notes: Replaces the cog button; call `open` to open the panel.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CollectionPreferences from '@aziontech/webkit/collection-preferences'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const columns = [
    { id: 'name', label: 'Name', locked: true },
    { id: 'status', label: 'Status' },
    { id: 'region', label: 'Region' },
    { id: 'requests', label: 'Requests' }
  ]

  const preferences = ref({
    pageSize: 25,
    columns: [
      { id: 'name', visible: true },
      { id: 'status', visible: true },
      { id: 'region', visible: false },
      { id: 'requests', visible: true }
    ],
    wrapLines: false,
    striped: false,
    density: 'comfortable'
  })
</script>

<template>
  <CollectionPreferences
    v-model:preferences="preferences"
    :columns="columns"
    :page-size-options="[10, 25, 50, 100]"
  />
</template>

examples.name: InADrawer
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import CollectionPreferences from '@aziontech/webkit/collection-preferences'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const columns = [
    { id: 'name', label: 'Name', locked: true },
    { id: 'domain', label: 'Domain' },
    { id: 'status', label: 'Status' }
  ]

  const preferences = ref({ density: 'compact' })
</script>

<template>
  <CollectionPreferences
    v-model:preferences="preferences"
    :columns="columns"
    :sections="['columns', 'density']"
    container="drawer"
  >
    <template #trigger="{ open }">
      <Button
        label="Table settings"
        icon="pi pi-cog"
        kind="outlined"
        size="medium"
        @click="open"
      />
    </template>
  </CollectionPreferences>
</template>
